## External display

- With Match TV Resolution on, switching between External Display and Mirror Display mid-stream now changes the resolution too: the stream reconnects in a few seconds at the TV's resolution on the TV, or at the one in Stream Settings on the device, while the game keeps running on the PC. The game's art and the connection progress show on the screen the stream is moving to.
- The same happens when you plug the TV in or out mid-stream. With Match TV Resolution off, nothing reconnects: the stream just moves screens, as before.

## Stream stats

- The stats overlay now shows both the resolution Starlight asked for and the one the PC is actually sending.
